authority: Pinned native synthetic feature semantics and driver integrity only; no real computation qualification, feature activation, remote rollout or whole-goal acceptance.

nativeReport.normalization: Canonical JSON whitespace only; decoded tracked data equals the captured report exactly.

driverIntegrity.authority: Controlled fixture-driver integrity only; no production setting or qualification changed.

consumerGuard.requirement: Matching selected task ID, nonempty command other than <NONEXISTENT>, and a native execution record. A native zero exit alone is not selected computation evidence.
consumerGuard.scope: Source identity and compatible native observations, not new consumer qualification.

observations: Strict selection removes a package-filtered missing command entrypoint; default selection executes its real dependency. Both native exits are zero, and neither produces selected-command evidence.
Explicit empty#probe keeps commandless nodes and real prerequisites in both modes; strict selection does not make an explicit missing task executable.

Graph-only collect remains available in both modes. Default mode contains two additional commandless probe/prepare nodes; strict mode removes those extra entrypoints while preserving the required real dependency.
A selected real task retains its commandless dependency as a transit node and executes all required real probe/prepare tasks in both modes.
--only removes other-name prepare prerequisites but retains same-name probe dependencies and commandless transit nodes. Do not treat it as a general dependency bypass.

Excluding every package yields a successful empty selection with no execution record. Missing tasks/packages/paths, unresolved package selectors and malformed regex selectors fail for their intended reasons without output markers.
